```python
def apply_move(board, move_str, player):
    parts = move_str.split(':')
    fr, fc = map(int, parts[0].split(','))
    tr, tc = map(int, parts[1].split(','))
    ar, ac = map(int, parts[2].split(','))
    new_board = board.copy()
    new_board[fr, fc] = 0
    new_board[tr, tc] = player
    new_board[ar, ac] = -1
    return new_board
```
